text: All city ledgers and household registers have been converted to a computational format that supports cross-checking.
National Long-Distance Transport Organization

Interregional supply lines and service staffing are now standardized. Under the district “Processing” category, you can allocate materials to build a national long-distance service station, assign six registered residents to staff it, and formally dispatch a liaison mission to a distant polity.
Robot Automatic Control

Servo drives, closed-loop control, and safety lockout procedures have been successfully prototyped. Robot assembly workshops can now be built; but paper schematics cannot fight your wars for you. A long-distance mechanized campaign still requires allocating actual robots and accompanying supplies.
Near-Earth Orbit Mapping

Observatories in three locations have mapped the debris belts and communication windows over near-Earth orbit. From now on, newly launched national long-distance operations will take 20% less time one way (teams already en route are unchanged). Spacecraft manufacturing and closed-loop life support still require further development.
